title: docs: SCHEMA.md's `interface Task` omits 11 keys the daemon writes, among them comments (on all 1058 live task files, and no TaskComment shape anywhere in the doc), hasPendingQuestion, the planSubmittedAt/planApprovedAt/workStartedAt/completedAt stamps and priorBlockedReason; its EpicStatus omits 'ARCHIVED', Team omits formerMemberIds and PlanCritiqueResult omits category
description:
Filed by hunt #24 (task-53801f5d, architect-cd0ac706) on 2026-11-04. It comes from two read-only scripted diffs at 1fef1b76, the moe/work-2026-10-24 tip after acb1c766:
- the key sets of every live .moe/tasks, epics, workers and attempts JSON file, against docs/SCHEMA.md's interfaces;
- packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts's interfaces, against the same doc.

PROBLEM. SCHEMA.md is the canonical data-shape doc (CLAUDE.md). Its Task interface (SCHEMA.md:434-612) leaves out fields the daemon writes on most task files. Task comments, the data the IDE boards and get_pending_questions run on, have no documented shape at all. Three smaller shapes have also drifted. Worker (16 keys) and ExecutionAttempt (17 keys) match exactly, so they are not in scope.

EVIDENCE: the types/schema.ts line, then the writers, under packages/moe-daemon/src/.
- comments: TaskComment[]
  - Declared at types/schema.ts:1059; its shape {id, author, content, timestamp} is at :511-516.
  - Writers: state/taskStore.ts:347 (create) and tools/addComment.ts:111-123 (author is the workerId, else 'agent').
  - Live: 1058 of 1058 task files. All 1310 comments carry exactly those 4 keys.
- hasPendingQuestion?
  - Declared at types/schema.ts:1060.
  - Writers: taskStore.ts:348 (false at create), server/WebSocketServer.ts:976 (true on a human comment), tools/addComment.ts:123 (false), and tools/waitForTask.ts:331 and :467.
  - Live: 912 files.
- planSubmittedAt?, planApprovedAt?, workStartedAt?, completedAt?
  - Declared at types/schema.ts:1034-1037.
  - Writers: planSubmittedAt at tools/submitPlan.ts:562; planApprovedAt at state/taskStore.ts:782, tools/submitPlan.ts:138 and :591, and tools/setTaskStatus.ts:259; workStartedAt at tools/startStep.ts:74; completedAt at tools/qaApprove.ts:247, stamped only at DONE (completeTask.ts:275).
  - Live: 891, 885, 878 and 875 files.
  - SCHEMA.md's own prose already names workStartedAt (:610) and planApprovedAt (:784), but the interface declares neither.
- priorBlockedReason?
  - Declared at types/schema.ts:1171.
  - Writers: tools/archiveTask.ts:25, tools/setTaskStatus.ts:203, state/resourceStore.ts:404 and :543, and server/WebSocketServer.ts:532.
  - Live: 98 files.
- Daemon-written, but on no live file yet:
  - needsHumanReview? (types/schema.ts:1138): set by tools/qaReject.ts:321, which parks the row unassigned, and cleared at WebSocketServer.ts:557.
  - capReplanAt? (:1148): set by qaReject.ts:323.
  - critiqueBlockCount? (:1155): set by tools/submitPlanCritique.ts:134 and tools/submitPlan.ts:670, and cleared by util/reopen.ts:63 and qaApprove.ts:252.
  - requiredCheckSnapshot? (:953): set by submitPlan.ts:576 and taskStore.ts:603. Its own section is SCHEMA.md:830, but the interface does not declare it.
- EpicStatus: types/schema.ts:43 includes 'ARCHIVED', which tools/archiveEpic.ts:93 writes. SCHEMA.md:386-389 lists only PLANNED, ACTIVE and COMPLETED.
- Team.formerMemberIds?: declared at types/schema.ts:411 and written by state/teamStore.ts:136 and :151 and state/workerStore.ts:305 and :500. It is on 5 of the 6 live team files. SCHEMA.md:1204-1218 does not declare it.
- PlanCritiqueResult.category?: declared at types/schema.ts:624 as PLAN_CRITIQUE_CATEGORIES | 'uncategorized', and written by tools/submitPlanCritique.ts:96-99. SCHEMA.md:1076-1081 does not declare it.

SCRIPTED DIFF, re-run at 1fef1b76. Scripts, outputs and a README are in /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt24/.
node /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt24/ts-vs-doc.mjs packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts docs/SCHEMA.md Task TaskComment Epic Team PlanCritiqueResult Worker ExecutionAttempt
It prints the following and exits 1:
## Task: ts L883-1193 (77) doc L434-612 (66)
  TS-ONLY (undocumented): requiredCheckSnapshot?@ts:953, planSubmittedAt?@ts:1034, planApprovedAt?@ts:1035, workStartedAt?@ts:1036, completedAt?@ts:1037, comments@ts:1059, hasPendingQuestion?@ts:1060, needsHumanReview?@ts:1138, capReplanAt?@ts:1148, critiqueBlockCount?@ts:1155, priorBlockedReason?@ts:1171
## TaskComment: ts L511 doc MISSING
## Team: TS-ONLY (undocumented): formerMemberIds?@ts:411
## PlanCritiqueResult: TS-ONLY (undocumented): category?@ts:624
SCHEMA-PARITY-FAIL 14
The live-file diff agrees on every Task key that live files carry: `node /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt24/parity-schema.mjs .moe docs/SCHEMA.md`, which reads the files and never writes them.

FIX DIRECTION. Docs only, in docs/SCHEMA.md.
- Declare each missing key in its interface, under Task's Timestamps, Reopening, Block bookkeeping and Governance groups, plus a new Comments group. Give each a one-line comment saying when it is set, written from its writer rather than from this text.
- Add `interface TaskComment` under Task subtypes.
- Add 'ARCHIVED' to EpicStatus, with what sets it: archive_epic, or update_epic with status ARCHIVED.
- Add formerMemberIds to Team, as join_team's eviction tombstone.
- Add category to PlanCritiqueResult.
- planningNotes is already documented in `## PlanningNotes` and needs no change.

NOT IN SCOPE.
- docs/MCP_SERVER.md, which has its own hunt #24 row.
- Any change to code or to types/schema.ts.
- Worker, ExecutionAttempt, Project and the settings shapes. CONFIGURATION.md belongs to CQ-M07v1.
- Prose outside the four named shapes.

VERIFICATION, from the worktree root. Both commands run in place and are read-only:
cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && npm run lint > /dev/null && echo LINT-OK && node /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt24/ts-vs-doc.mjs packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts docs/SCHEMA.md Task TaskComment Epic Team PlanCritiqueResult Worker ExecutionAttempt && sed -n '/^type EpicStatus/,/;/p' docs/SCHEMA.md | grep -q "'ARCHIVED'" && echo EPICSTATUS-OK

implementationPlan.description:
Edit docs/SCHEMA.md with your own Edit tool (project rail: no shell writes to tracked files): the three small shapes plus the missing interface TaskComment.
Rules for every new key in steps 1-2: optionality exactly as packages/moe-daemon/src/types/schema.ts; ONE comment, on the key's own line, saying when it is set (and what clears it), taken from the writer named here (all verified at 80078651); no source line numbers in the doc text; never put the two-character sequence slash-star or star-slash inside a // comment within an interface body (e.g. `.moe/tasks/*.json`): /mnt/d/moe-scratch/hunt24/ts-vs-doc.mjs reads it as a block-comment start and drops every later key, so parity fails.
(a) `## Epic`, `type EpicStatus` (SCHEMA.md:386-389). Change `  | 'COMPLETED';   // All tasks done` to `  | 'COMPLETED'    // All tasks done` (drop only the `;`) and add 'ARCHIVED' as the LAST member, carrying the `;`. The DoD's `sed -n '/^type EpicStatus/,/;/p'` range stops at the first `;` and `grep -c "'ARCHIVED'"` counts lines, so no other line of the type may hold a `;` or the text 'ARCHIVED'. Writers: moe.archive_epic writes status ARCHIVED after archiving every task (tools/archiveEpic.ts:84-93); moe.update_epic and the board's UPDATE_EPIC with status ARCHIVED run archive_epic (applyEpicUpdate in tools/updateEpic.ts). Suggested line:
  | 'ARCHIVED';    // Shelved: set by moe.archive_epic once it has archived every task, or by moe.update_epic (or the board's UPDATE_EPIC) with status ARCHIVED, which runs archive_epic
(b) `## Team`, `interface Team` (:1204-1218): after the `memberIds` line add `formerMemberIds?: string[];` (its comment must contain `evict`). Writers: state/workerStore.ts:305 (worker record deleted: stale sweep, DEAD prune) and :500 (restart purge) move members into it; state/teamStore.ts:151 (evictDeadMembers: a join into a full team evicts its DEAD members); teamStore.ts:136 (clearMembershipTombstone) drops the id when that worker joins or leaves any team. Read only to auto-rejoin a returning worker (util/teamMembershipHeal.ts), never counted toward maxSize. Suggested line:
  formerMemberIds?: string[];    // Eviction tombstone: members whose worker record was deleted (stale sweep, DEAD prune, restart purge) or DEAD members a join into a full team evicted; read only to auto-rejoin a returning worker, never counted toward maxSize; cleared when it joins or leaves any team
(c) `### Task subtypes`, `interface PlanCritiqueResult` (:1076-1081): after the `concerns?:` line add the category key, typed as the literal union of PLAN_CRITIQUE_CATEGORIES (types/schema.ts) plus 'uncategorized'. Writer: tools/submitPlanCritique.ts:44-52 and :96-100 store a sent category as sent (validated, any verdict), store 'uncategorized' for a block sent without one, and store none for a pass sent without one; the daemon size critic's block (tools/submitPlan.ts:663-676) carries none. Suggested line:
  category?: 'size' | 'correctness' | 'rails' | 'dependency' | 'uncategorized'; // As sent; 'uncategorized' = a block sent without one; absent on a pass sent without one and on the daemon size critic's block
(d) `### Task subtypes`: directly before `interface RejectionDetails {` (:974) add interface TaskComment, the 4 required string keys of types/schema.ts:511-516, with a short /** */ header above it (outside the body, so allowed). `interface TaskComment {` must stand alone on its line (the parser needs the `{` at end of line). Facts: id = generateId('comment'); moe.add_comment sets author to the caller's workerId, else 'agent' (tools/addComment.ts:109-114); the board's /ws ADD_COMMENT uses the sent author, else 'human' (server/WebSocketServer.ts:963-968); both trim content and refuse empty or >10000 chars (MAX_TASK_COMMENT_LENGTH, addComment.ts:10). The `author:` line must contain `add_comment`. Suggested block, followed by a blank line:
/**
 * One entry of `task.comments`, appended by `moe.add_comment` or the board's
 * `/ws` ADD_COMMENT. Both refuse empty or over-10000-char content.
 */
interface TaskComment {
  id: string;                // "comment-…"
  author: string;            // moe.add_comment: the caller's workerId, else 'agent'; board: the sent author, else 'human'
  content: string;           // Trimmed, ≤10000 chars
  timestamp: string;         // ISO 8601
}
Leave every other line of these shapes alone (e.g. PlanCritiqueResult.reviewedBy, the Team prose): out of scope.
implementationPlan.note: EpicStatus ARCHIVED, Team.formerMemberIds, PlanCritiqueResult.category, TaskComment added

implementationPlan.description:
Edit docs/SCHEMA.md `## Task`, `interface Task` (:434-612) with your Edit tool, under the step-1 rules: declare the 11 keys types/schema.ts has and the doc lacks (comments required; the other ten optional). Each key line must contain the token in [brackets]: check piece 3 reads the key line plus any // continuation lines directly under it. Write from the writers below, not from types/schema.ts's comments or the task description: types/schema.ts:1130-1138 claims the critique-block cap also sets needsHumanReview, but tools/submitPlanCritique.ts:120-125 says it does not; and per the filer's task comment, waitForTask.ts:331/:467 are reply fields, not task writes.
1. After `  executionContract?: TaskExecutionContract;` (:468): requiredCheckSnapshot?: RequiredCheckSnapshot [submit_plan]. Daemon-owned; only moe.submit_plan's PLAN_SUBMITTED write sets it, and a plan without requiredChecks clears it (tools/submitPlan.ts:575-577; every other writer has it stripped). Point at the existing `### requiredCheckSnapshot (CQ-V01)` section.
2. Reopening group, after the `maxReopens?:` line (:493): capReplanAt?: string [qa_reject]: ISO time of the qa_reject that reached the reopen cap and flipped the row to PLANNING for its one re-plan (tools/qaReject.ts:205-228, :323); never cleared, a reopen keeps it. Then needsHumanReview?: boolean [qa_reject]: set true by a qa_reject past the cap once capReplanAt is set; the row stays REVIEW, its assignee cleared, fenced out of every QA claim (qaReject.ts:321). Cleared by qa_approve (qaApprove.ts:251), every reopen (util/reopen.ts:62), release_task (releaseTask.ts:270, :320), set_task_status (setTaskStatus.ts:242-243) and a board move into REVIEW (server/WebSocketServer.ts:556-557).
3. Block bookkeeping, right after the `blockedReason?:` line (:513): priorBlockedReason?: string | null [set_task_status]: the last blockedReason, copied when set_task_status (setTaskStatus.ts:203), a board move (WebSocketServer.ts:532) or archive_task (archiveTask.ts:25) takes the row out of BLOCKED, or a resource restore returns it unassigned (state/resourceStore.ts:404 releaseOnDeregister, :543 unheld queue head). The lease grant (resourceStore.ts:577-585), the dependency auto-unblock (state/dependencyUnblock.ts:274-281) and unblock_worker (unblockWorker.ts:79-86) do not copy it, and nothing clears it, so its comment must say it is kept, unlike the group's other keys.
4. Governance group, after the `planCritiqueResult?:` line (:581): critiqueBlockCount?: number [submit_plan_critique]: +1 per critique block that flips the row to PLANNING, from moe.submit_plan_critique (submitPlanCritique.ts:128-134) or submit_plan's own size critic under settings.taskSizing.autoCritique (submitPlan.ts:663-670); at MAX_CRITIQUE_BLOCKS_DEFAULT (2) a block stops flipping; cleared by qa_approve (qaApprove.ts:252) and every reopen (util/reopen.ts:63).
5. New Comments group, before `  // Ownership + ordering bookkeeping (Phase 3; both optional)` (:603), with a `  // Comments: …` header line and a blank line after the group: comments: TaskComment[] [add_comment]: oldest first, appended by moe.add_comment and the board's ADD_COMMENT; every writer keeps the newest MAX_COMMENTS_PER_TASK (200, env MOE_MAX_COMMENTS_PER_TASK; state/validators.ts:45-52, create at taskStore.ts:347). Then hasPendingQuestion?: boolean ['human' and add_comment]: false at create_task (taskStore.ts:348) and on every moe.add_comment (addComment.ts:123); true on a board ADD_COMMENT whose author is 'human' (WebSocketServer.ts:974-976; another board author leaves it as is). Read by get_pending_questions and wait_for_task.
6. Timestamps group, between `  updatedAt: string;` and `  reviewStartedAt?: string;` (:609-610; anchor your Edit on both lines, since `  updatedAt: string;` occurs 6 times in the doc), in types/schema.ts order: planSubmittedAt?: string [submit_plan]: every moe.submit_plan, in its AWAITING_APPROVAL write (submitPlan.ts:562). planApprovedAt?: string [set_task_status]: every approval, in its status WORKING write: the board's approveTask (PLAN_APPROVED, state/taskStore.ts:782), SPEED/TURBO auto-approval (PLAN_AUTO_APPROVED, submitPlan.ts:138 and :591) and a relaxed-mode set_task_status approval (setTaskStatus.ts:257-259). workStartedAt?: string [start_step]: the first moe.start_step, never overwritten (startStep.ts:72-74); a reopen keeps it. completedAt?: string [qa_approve]: at DONE by moe.qa_approve, with reviewCompletedAt (qaApprove.ts:246-248); complete_task stamps only reviewStartedAt (completeTask.ts:275); every reopen clears it (util/reopen.ts:58).
Suggested lines, dry-run green against all three check pieces at 80078651 (keep the comment column of the neighbouring lines):
  requiredCheckSnapshot?: RequiredCheckSnapshot; // Daemon-owned: set, or cleared by a plan without requiredChecks, only by moe.submit_plan's PLAN_SUBMITTED write. See `requiredCheckSnapshot` below
  capReplanAt?: string;                         // ISO time of the qa_reject that reached the reopen cap and flipped the row to PLANNING for its one re-plan; never cleared
  needsHumanReview?: boolean;                   // true from a qa_reject past the cap once capReplanAt is set (row stays REVIEW, unassigned, out of QA claims); cleared by qa_approve, a reopen, release_task, set_task_status or a board move into REVIEW
  priorBlockedReason?: string | null;    // The last blockedReason, kept when set_task_status, a board move, archive_task or a resource restore that returns the row unassigned takes it out of BLOCKED (the lease grant, dependency auto-unblock and unblock_worker do not copy it); never cleared
  critiqueBlockCount?: number;                  // +1 per critique block that flips the row to PLANNING (moe.submit_plan_critique, or submit_plan's size critic under taskSizing.autoCritique); at 2 a block stops flipping; cleared by qa_approve and every reopen
  // Comments: questions and answers on the task (TaskComment below)
  comments: TaskComment[];       // Oldest first, appended by moe.add_comment and the board's ADD_COMMENT; every writer keeps the newest 200 (MOE_MAX_COMMENTS_PER_TASK)
  hasPendingQuestion?: boolean;  // true on a board comment whose author is 'human'; false at create_task and on every moe.add_comment. Read by get_pending_questions and wait_for_task
  planSubmittedAt?: string;      // Set by every moe.submit_plan, in its AWAITING_APPROVAL write
  planApprovedAt?: string;       // Set with status WORKING by every approval: the board's (PLAN_APPROVED), SPEED/TURBO auto-approval (PLAN_AUTO_APPROVED) and a relaxed-mode set_task_status approval
  workStartedAt?: string;        // Set by the first moe.start_step and never overwritten; a reopen keeps it
  completedAt?: string;          // Set at DONE by moe.qa_approve, with reviewCompletedAt (complete_task stamps only reviewStartedAt); every reopen clears it

Final step: adversarial self-review of the whole docs/SCHEMA.md diff, then the one verification run (its fresh output is your complete_task evidence).
Review as an attacker: (1) re-open every writer line cited in steps 1-2 and confirm each new comment says exactly who sets the key, when, and what clears it; fix any claim copied from types/schema.ts comments or the task text instead of the code. (2) The diff is additive apart from the EpicStatus 'COMPLETED' line losing its `;`: no existing line reworded, rewrapped or moved, and every ```typescript fence still closes. (3) No added line holds deprecated, seed, wallClockMs, firstClaimAt, pacePerStepMs, TaskBudget, task.budget or a 'never runs git' phrase: packages/moe-daemon/src/util/taskTimeBudgetDocs.test.ts and daemonGitDocs.test.ts scan every SCHEMA.md line for them (check piece 2 enforces this on added lines, so a docs-only diff needs no snapshot npm run). (4) `git diff --stat` shows only docs/SCHEMA.md (about +28/-1). (5) You edited only your worktree's docs/SCHEMA.md, never the control checkout's.
Error handling: this docs-only diff adds no runtime path, so the only failure handling is the check chain, which fails closed: each piece exits non-zero and prints a MISSING, SCHEMA-PARITY-FAIL, OPTIONALITY or diff line. Never append `|| true`, drop a piece or edit the oracle script; fix the doc and re-run.
